title: Zeus Profile
description: An Arma 3 dedicated server profile managed by zeus. Profiles are stored as JSON in ~/.zeus/profiles/<name>.json and can be submitted to the agent via the profile.add command.

name.description: Unique profile identifier. Used as the storage key and in generated file paths.

executable.description: Path to the Arma 3 server executable. Defaults to arma3server_x64 (Linux/macOS) or arma3server_x64.exe (Windows) inside install_dir.

install_dir.description: Absolute path to the Arma 3 installation directory. All generated configs and relative server paths are resolved from here.

params.description: Arma 3 startup command-line parameters. All fields are optional; omitted fields are not passed to the server.

config.description: Arma 3 server.cfg parameters. All fields are optional; omitted fields use Arma 3 engine defaults.

basic.description: Arma 3 basic.cfg network-tuning parameters. All fields are optional.

missionSource.description: Optional mission file sync configuration used by missions.pull.

rcon.description: BattlEye RCon connection settings written to the BattlEye config file.

hooks.description: Optional ordered shell commands to run at profile lifecycle events. The first failure in a list aborts the remaining commands.

DataSize.description: A byte count. Accepts a JSON number (raw bytes) or a string with a unit suffix. Supported suffixes: B, KB, MB, GB, TB, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB. Examples: 1024, "5MB", "2GiB".

DataTransferRate.description: A bandwidth value in bits per second. Accepts a JSON number (raw bps) or a string with a unit suffix. Supported suffixes: bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps, Tbps. Examples: 100000000, "100Mbps", "1Gbps".

FilePatchingMode.description: Controls which clients may join with -filePatching. 0=no clients allowed, 1=Headless Clients only, 2=all clients.

KickSource.description: Origin of a kick action for use in kickTimeout. 0=manual (vote kick, admin kick, bruteforce detection), 1=connectivity (ping, timeout, packetloss, desync), 2=BattlEye, 3=harmless (wrong addons, steam timeout/checks, signatures).

SignatureVerification.description: Addon signature checking mode. 0=disabled, 2=v2 .bisign files only accepted.

ZeusScriptLevel.description: Scripts Zeus compositions may execute. 0=forbidden, 1=attributes only (default), 2=all including init scripts.

RotorLibMode.description: Flight model enforced server-side. 0=player choice, 1=Advanced Flight Model forced, 2=Standard Flight Model forced.

TimestampFormat.description: Format of timestamps in the server RPT log.

HazeQualityLevel.description: Forces haze rendering quality on all MP clients. -1=do not force (default), 0=very low, 1=low, 2=standard.

timeout.description: Seconds a kicked player must wait before rejoining. Positive = seconds, -1 = until mission end, -2 = until server restart.

text.description: true = disable text chat on this channel.

voice.description: true = disable VON (voice) on this channel.

mapMarkers.description: true = disable manual map markers on this channel.

drawOnMap.description: true = disable Ctrl+LMB map drawing on this channel.

logObjectNotFound.description: false = skip 'Server: Object not found' log messages. Reduces log noise on large missions.

skipDescriptionParsing.description: true = skip description.ext/mission.sqm parsing; builds the mission list faster but breaks overviewText and similar metadata.

ignoreMissionLoadErrors.description: true = load mission regardless of loading errors; false = abort on errors.

queueSizeLogG.description: Dump player message types to the RPT log when the Guaranteed Queue exceeds this threshold in bytes. 0 = disabled.

cycleTime.description: Cycle length in seconds. Every cycle, if a player exceeds cycleLimit messages they are flagged.

cycleLimit.description: Message count per cycle that triggers a flag.

cycleHardLimit.description: Message count that immediately triggers action (kick or log) within one cycle.

enableKick.description: true = kick flagged players; false = log only.

customName.description: Class name in the generated server.cfg. Defaults to 'MissionN' (N = 1-based index) if omitted.

template.description: Mission template in the form 'missionName.terrainName', e.g. 'MP_Marksmen_01.Altis'.

params.description: Mission parameter overrides; keys match description.ext parameter names, values are integer indices.

maxPacketSize.description: Maximum UDP packet size in bytes.

MissionSource.description: Describes where mission .pbo files are fetched from when running missions.pull.

driver.description: 'path' = local filesystem (copy or symlink). 's3' = Amazon S3 or compatible (e.g. MinIO).

path.description: Absolute path to the source mission directory (path driver).

mode.description: How files are placed in the mpmissions directory. 'copy' (default) copies each .pbo; 'symlink' replaces the entire mpmissions directory with a symlink to path.

prefix.description: S3 key prefix used to scope which objects are synced (s3 driver). Objects outside this prefix are excluded. Only flat objects are synced; keys that still contain '/' after stripping the prefix are skipped.

endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL (s3 driver), e.g. 'http://localhost:9000' for MinIO.

region.description: AWS region or S3-compatible region string (s3 driver).

RCon.description: BattlEye RCon settings written to the BattlEye config file at profile registration time.

password.description: RCon password. zeus auto-generates an MD5-based password from the profile name if not set explicitly.

port.description: RCon listen port. zeus defaults to gamePort - 1 (e.g. 2301 when the game port is 2302).

ip.description: RCon bind IP address. Defaults to 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces) when omitted.

ProfileHooks.description: Ordered shell commands to run at lifecycle events. Commands in each list run sequentially; the first failure aborts the remaining commands in that list.

postPullMissions.description: Commands run after missions.pull completes successfully.

postProfileAdd.description: Commands run after profile.add completes (after .cfg files are generated).

preProfileStart.description: Commands run before the server process is launched by profile.start.

postProfileStart.description: Commands run after the server process is launched by profile.start.

preProfileStop.description: Commands run before profile.stop sends the termination signal.

postProfileStop.description: Commands run after the server process has stopped.

preProfileRun.description: Commands run immediately before exec'ing the server binary (inside the runner).

postProfileRun.description: Commands run after the server binary exits (inside the runner).

StartupParams.description: Arma 3 dedicated server startup parameters. Nil/omitted fields are not passed to the server binary.

world.description: World to load on startup. Use 'empty' to disable the default world load.

name.description: Server profile name (used for the Arma 3 profile directory, not the zeus profile name).

profiles.description: Path to the Arma 3 profiles folder.

doNothing.description: Start without doing anything; used for testing and diagnostics.

mod.description: Client-side mod folders to load. Sent to connecting clients.

mpMissions.description: Custom mpmissions folder path relative to the Arma 3 installation directory.

server.description: Run as a dedicated server. Usually implicit when starting via zeus.

pid.description: Path for the server PID file; the engine removes it automatically on clean exit.

ranking.description: Path for the server ranking file.

netlog.description: Enable network traffic logging to the RPT log.

cfg.description: Path to basic.cfg (network performance tuning). zeus sets this automatically from the profile's basic section.

config.description: Path to server.cfg. zeus sets this automatically from the profile's config section.

bePath.description: Custom BattlEye folder path. Defaults to the BattlEye subfolder inside the profiles folder.

ip.description: Bind IP address for multihome servers.

par.description: Path to a startup parameter config file (-par).

loadMissionToMemory.description: Load the current mission entirely into memory; reduces mission-change lag.

autoInit.description: Auto-select and start a mission on server startup. Requires persistent=true in server.cfg; breaks mission parameter dialogs.

serverMod.description: Server-side-only mod folders. Not sent to connecting clients.

bandwidthAlg.description: Networking algorithm variant. Set to 2 to enable the experimental algorithm.

keysFolder.description: Paths to folders containing .bikey files. Use '!keys' as an entry to exclude the default base-game keys folder.

limitFPS.description: FPS limit for the dedicated server process. Default 50.

maxMem.description: Maximum memory allocation in MiB. Minimum 1024.

maxFileCacheSize.description: File cache size in MiB. Minimum 512; recommended ≥1024.

cpuCount.description: Override CPU core count detected by the engine (≥2 required since Arma 3 2.20).

cpuAffinity.description: Process CPU affinity mask as a hex string, e.g. '0xFF'.

cpuMainThreadAffinity.description: Main-thread CPU affinity mask as a hex string, e.g. '0x01'.

enableHT.description: Enable logical CPU cores (HyperThreading). Overridden when cpuCount or cpuAffinity is set.

hugePages.description: Enable huge pages memory allocation (Linux only).

noFreezeCheck.description: Disable the server freeze detection watchdog.

filePatching.description: Allow loading files from non-signed (unsigned) locations.

beta.description: Beta mod paths. Multiple stacked folders and absolute paths are supported.

cfgDependenciesDebugPrint.description: Print config dependency debug information on startup.

preprocDefine.description: Preprocessor macro definitions. Each entry is 'MACRO' or 'MACRO=VALUE'.

dumpAddonDependencyGraph.description: Dump the addon dependency graph to a file on startup.

networkDiagInterval.description: Seconds between network diagnostics log entries.

ServerConfig.description: Arma 3 server.cfg parameters. All fields are optional. Omitted fields fall back to Arma 3 engine defaults.

password.description: Server join password. Empty = public server.

hostname.description: Server name shown in the game browser. Defaults to the local machine name when empty.

logFile.description: Path to the server log (RPT) file.

motd.description: Message of the Day lines displayed periodically to players.

motdInterval.description: Seconds between each MOTD display. Default 5.

headlessClients.description: IP addresses allowed to connect as Headless Clients.

localClient.description: IP addresses treated as local (no bandwidth restrictions).

filePatchingExceptions.description: Steam64 IDs always allowed to join with -filePatching regardless of allowedFilePatching.

missionWhitelist.description: If non-empty, only missions whose class names appear in this list can be selected.

voteThreshold.description: Fraction of players required to pass a vote (0.0–1.0). Default 0.5.

voteMissionPlayers.description: Minimum players online before mission voting is enabled. Default 1.

kickduplicate.description: true = kick players who attempt to connect with a duplicate Steam ID.

loopback.description: true = server visible only on localhost (for local testing).

persistent.description: true = server stays online between missions (required for autoInit).

autoSelectMission.description: true = automatically start the first mission in the rotation without waiting for a vote.

enablePlayerDiag.description: true = enable detailed per-player diagnostics in the RPT log.

allowedLoadFileExtensions.description: File extensions that scripts may load with loadFile/preprocessFile.

allowedPreprocessFileExtensions.description: File extensions that preprocessFile is allowed to process.

allowedHTMLLoadExtensions.description: File extensions that createDialog / loadFile may load as HTML.

allowedHTMLLoadURIs.description: URIs that HTML dialogs may load content from.

maxPing.description: Maximum allowed client ping in ms. Negative = disabled (no limit). Default -1.

maxPacketLoss.description: Maximum allowed packet loss percentage. Negative = disabled. Default -1.

maxDesync.description: Maximum allowed desync value. Negative = disabled. Default -1.

disconnectTimeout.description: Seconds to wait before disconnecting a player on lost connection. Range 1–90. Default 15.

kickClientsOnSlowNetwork.description: Per-threshold action array: [maxPing, maxPacketLoss, maxDesync, disconnectTimeout]. 0=log only, 1=kick. Default [1,1,1,1].

callExtReportLimit.description: Warn in the RPT log when callExtension takes longer than this many milliseconds. Default 1000.

votingTimeOut.description: Mission voting screen timeout in seconds. One value, or [ready, notReady] pair. Default [60, 90].

roleTimeOut.description: Role selection screen timeout in seconds. One value, or [ready, notReady] pair. Default [90, 120].

briefingTimeOut.description: Briefing screen timeout in seconds. One value, or [ready, notReady] pair. Default [60, 90].

debriefingTimeOut.description: Debriefing screen timeout in seconds. One value, or [ready, notReady] pair. Default [45, 60].

lobbyIdleTimeout.description: Maximum lobby idle time in seconds. At least max(votingTimeout, roleTimeout, briefingTimeout, debriefingTimeout) + 5 s regardless of this setting.

missionsToServerRestart.description: Restart the server process after this many mission ends. 0 = disabled.

missionsToShutdown.description: Shut down the server process after this many mission ends. 0 = disabled.

equalModRequired.description: true = clients must have exactly the same mods as the server.

battleye.description: true = enable BattlEye anti-cheat. Default true.

drawingInMap.description: true = allow players to draw on the map. Default true.

disableVoN.description: true = disable Voice over Network globally.

skipLobby.description: true = skip the lobby screen and go directly to the game.

allowProfileGlasses.description: true = allow players to use their profile's custom glasses. Default true.

doubleIdDetected.description: SQF expression executed when a duplicate player ID is detected.

onUserConnected.description: SQF expression executed when a player connects.

onUserDisconnected.description: SQF expression executed when a player disconnects.

onHackedData.description: SQF expression executed when hacked/modified data is detected.

onDifferentData.description: SQF expression executed when mismatched addon data is detected.

onUnsignedData.description: SQF expression executed when unsigned addon data is detected.

onUserKicked.description: SQF expression executed when a player is kicked.

regularCheck.description: SQF expression executed periodically for server-side integrity checks.

requiredBuild.description: Minimum Arma 3 build number required to join. 0 = no restriction.

statisticsEnabled.description: true = send anonymous server statistics to Bohemia Interactive. Default true.

forcedDifficulty.description: Force all missions to run at this difficulty level.

steamProtocolMaxDataSize.description: Maximum response payload size for Steam protocol queries. Default 1024 bytes.

armaUnitsTimeout.description: Seconds before Arma Units membership check times out. Default 30.

missionHTTPDownloadBaseURL.description: Base URL for HTTP mission downloads. Clients receive mission files via this URL instead of the game protocol.

BasicServerConfig.description: Arma 3 basic.cfg network-tuning parameters. All fields are optional.

maxMsgSend.description: Maximum number of messages sent per simulation step. Default 128.

maxSizeGuaranteed.description: Maximum size in bytes of a guaranteed (reliable) network message. Default 512.

maxSizeNonguaranteed.description: Maximum size in bytes of a non-guaranteed (unreliable) network message. Default 256.

minBandwidth.description: Minimum bandwidth the server assumes each client has.

maxBandwidth.description: Maximum bandwidth the server will use per client. Default 100Mbps.

minErrorToSend.description: Minimum positional error (world units) before an update is sent to distant clients. Default 0.001.

minErrorToSendNear.description: Minimum positional error (world units) before an update is sent to nearby clients. Default 0.01.

maxCustomFileSize.description: Maximum size in bytes of custom face/sound files players may upload. Default 1024.
